purpose_context: The 2026-09-04 docsite review (#64) found glossary term links are visually indistinguishable from ordinary links, open in a new tab unlike other internal links, and the hover popover lacks a caret and never flips upward near the viewport bottom. This mission polishes those three so glossary terms read as a distinct 'hover-for-definition' affordance without breaking the shared-link-node invariant, the re-derive parity guard, the no-JS fallback, or presence-gated dormancy.
purpose_tldr: Make autolinked glossary terms read distinct-but-quiet, open in the same tab, and give the hover popover a caret + viewport-aware flip.
